system.description:
Wall-defence tradition, volleys and coordinated fire.

  • Volley Timing: Once per encounter, when an ally hits a creature with a ranged attack, your next bow attack against it this round has Advantage.
  • Sentry's Patience: Advantage on Perception checks made during watch or sentry duty.
